descriptions.notStarted: A middle-aged gentleman who laims to have been the leader of a Family for 30 mind-boggling years... the rumors about this man, #bCaptain Al#k, who can be found in #bLith Harbor#k and #bOrbis Park#k, are running rampant. What exactly is a Family and the Leader anyway? It sounds interesting... better ask #bCaptain Al#k that question myself.
descriptions.inProgress: #bCaptain Al#k seemed much more pleasant the rumors suggested. I have a lot to ask... and he said ask him when I'm ready. How about now?
descriptions.completed: Captain Al's passion for adventure the Family are palpable. Forget the tear-jerking adventures of Captain Al; I'm more interested in the concept of the Family... \nFortunately, Captain Al told me to ask him anytime about the Family. Should I become a Leader myself? Well, first I'll need to find a Junior I can support.
